_comment: Player palettes for bead chopaat-xix (asset round 3). Colors are the
Design'), chosen for distinguishability under deuteranopia and
protanopia AND for contrast against the dark cloth (board_cloth
linear albedo ~0.02). 4p keeps the traditional pachisi red/green/
yellow + blue for the fourth seat (traditional black is unreadable
on the dark cloth). Verified by assets/scripts/colorblind_sim.py:
Machado et al. 2009 severity-1.0 CVD matrices in linear RGB, min
pairwise CIE76 deltaE asserted per palette per condition; simulated
contact sheets rendered alongside the originals.
linear_rgba are the values the runtime override path should use for
the pawn_body baseColorFactor (glTF linear factor semantics) — the
lib/ Setup tint update is the chopaat-xix follow-up, not this lane.
